rationale: Record correcting the capture integration suite's browser resolution to read PULP_DESIGN_BROWSER. PULP_BROWSER was referenced only by this one test helper; nothing in the repository sets it and no other reader exists, so the suite ignored the checksum-verified pinned Chrome for Testing the macOS gate provisions and fell through to whatever unpinned Chrome the host carried. The candidate list is otherwise unchanged and PULP_BROWSER remains honored as a secondary override. Test-only: no production browser capture, discovery, network policy, rendering, output, or packaging behavior changes. Watch-only: the exact capture route remains Pulp-owned and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority is transferred.
tests: confirm-failure: removing the PULP_DESIGN_BROWSER candidate makes the new preference test resolve /Applications/Google Chrome.app instead of the provisioned executable
